text: 创业板指冲高回落涨0.56%，PCB、煤炭板块集体走强。 恒指半日涨0.2%，恒生科技指数涨0.1%，恒生生物科技指数涨2%。 中国10月CPI同比增0.7%，中国10月PPI同比增5.7%，创2022年6月以来最高。 国务院关税税则委员会：在2个月内继续暂停实施24%的对美加征关税税率，保留10%的对美加征关税税率。 黄仁勋涉婚外情，发布致英伟达全员信，特朗普称仍愿意带黄仁勋出访亚洲。
text_en: ChiNext Index surged then pulled back, closing up 0.56%; PCB and coal sectors strengthened collectively. The Hang Seng Index rose 0.2% at midday, the Hang Seng Tech Index gained 0.1%, and the Hang Seng Biotech Index rose 2%. China's October CPI rose 0.7% year-on-year, and October PPI rose 5.7% year-on-year, the highest since June 2022. Tariff Commission of the State Council: the 24% additional tariff rate on US goods will continue to be suspended for two months, while the 10% additional tariff rate on US goods will be retained. Jensen Huang was involved in an extramarital affair and issued a letter to all Nvidia employees; Trump said he is still willing to take Jensen Huang on a trip to Asia.
